title: Enrolment never triggers a bulk send; the backlog goes to the worklist
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor with view and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset that has a customer, and a schedule to enrol it on. Seed them:
  3. ↳ Ensure a schedule exists (Settings > Maintenance > New schedule + at least one service).
  4. ↳ Open an asset that has a customer (from Customers > a customer > Assets, or from Work Orders) and open its Maintenance tab (the last tab on the asset page).
  5. Pick a schedule where several services are already due or overdue at the moment of enrolment (set last-service dates in the past).
custom_steps:
1. Enrol the asset and read the confirmation.
  2. Check the worklist for the already-due rows and their status.
  3. Confirm no email was sent for the backlog; check a service that falls due after enrolment.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Enrolment never triggers a bulk customer send; services already due or overdue at enrolment are suppressed from automatic email.
  • The confirmation states both halves: the rows appear on the worklist, and no emails are sent for them.
  • Nothing is suppressed internally - every row appears immediately with its real status; services falling due after enrolment send normally (suppression covers the backlog only).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10564 (S7, Enrol an asset onto a schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S7; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
